## Binomial wording → R code
> [!trigger] TRIGGER: "at least", "more than", "fewer than", "exactly", "at most"

| Plain English | Correct R code |
|---|---|
| exactly k | `dbinom(k, n, p)` |
| at most k / ≤ k | `pbinom(k, n, p)` |
| fewer than k / < k | `pbinom(k-1, n, p)` |
| **at least k / ≥ k** | **`1 - pbinom(k-1, n, p)`** |
| more than k / > k | `1 - pbinom(k, n, p)` |

> [!warn] **"30 or more out of 350"** → `1-pbinom(29, 350, p)` — subtract 1!

> [!bad] **NEVER** `1-pbinom(k, n, p)` for P(X ≥ k) ← that gives P(X>k)

## CLT / sampling distribution flow
> [!trigger] TRIGGER: "average of n", "sample mean", "standard error"

| Statistic | Distribution | SE |
|---|---|---|
| $\bar X$ | $N(\mu, \sigma/\sqrt n)$ | $\sigma/\sqrt n$ |
| $\hat p$ | $N(p, \sqrt{p(1-p)/n})$ | $\sqrt{p(1-p)/n}$ |
| $T_n$ (sum) | $N(n\mu, \sigma\sqrt n)$ | $\sigma\sqrt n$ |

**When CLT applies:** population already normal (any n) **OR** n large.

> [!warn] **SE = σ/√n — denominator is √n, NOT n**

> [!ok] e.g. N(1200,110), n=100 → SE = 110/√100 = **11**

## Hypothesis test flow
> [!trigger] TRIGGER: "H₀", "test if", "p-value", "evidence that", "reject"

**SETUP:** H₀: p = p₀ (equality) H_a: p >, <, or ≠ p₀

| Hₐ wording | Tail | p-value code |
|---|---|---|
| "more than" | right → | `1-pbinom(x-1, n, p₀)` |
| "less than" | left ← | `pbinom(x, n, p₀)` |
| "different" | two-sided | `2*min(left, right)` |

> [!bad] **p-val < α → REJECT H₀  |  p-val ≥ α → FAIL TO REJECT**

> [!warn] ⚠️ Always use **p₀** (null), never p̂

## Confidence interval flow
> [!trigger] TRIGGER: "confidence interval", "95% CI", "margin of error"

**BUILD:** $\text{Estimate} \pm z^* \cdot SE$ **READ (a,b):** PE=(a+b)/2, MOE=(b−a)/2

| Conf | z* | R code |
|---|---|---|
| 90% | 1.645 | `qnorm(0.95)` |
| **95%** | **1.960** | **`qnorm(0.975)`** |
| 99% | 2.576 | `qnorm(0.995)` |

> [!ok] ✔️ CORRECT: "If repeated many times, ~95% of such intervals would contain the true parameter."

> [!bad] ❌ "95% prob. this interval contains μ"
